answer: Sybil resistance here is a bonded work ladder: each new key must mill a timber of sequential, non-transferable attestations before it can vote or earn. The first privilege is a relic of unique compute receipts peers countersign on-ledger; weight then opens like a lotus only after many epochs of that history. An attacker spinning a thousand clones still pays the same scarce compute plus slashed collateral per fake, so swarming costs scale linearly in capital and time, not in copy-paste.
